item.title: Google Cloud 携手巨头发布 llm-d 1.0：面向 TPU 与 GPU 集群的缓存感知分布式推理技术栈
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/Google-Cloud-携手巨头发布-llm-d-1.0-面向-TPU-与-GPU-集群的缓存感知分布式推理技术栈/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/Google-Cloud-携手巨头发布-llm-d-1.0-面向-TPU-与-GPU-集群的缓存感知分布式推理技术栈/
item.description:
随着大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 智能体与复杂强化学习 (Reinforcement Learning, RL) 任务的兴起，传统的轮询负载均衡策略在面对极度依赖上下文缓存的复杂请求时显得捉襟见肘，极易导致严重的显存浪费与高延迟。为了攻克这一工业界普遍痛点，Google Cloud 联合 Red Hat、IBM、CoreWeave 以及 NVIDIA 等行业巨头，正式推出了首个开源且云原生 (Kubernetes-native) 的分布式推理框架 llm-d 1.0。llm-d 打破了过去 vLLM 与 SGLang 等模型服务端各自为政的碎片化局面，创新性地引入了前缀感知智能路由、多级分层缓存解耦以及预填充/解码分离编排机制，将模型服务器统一纳管为协同工作的资源池。在高达 17,000 节点的 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 超大规模集群测试中，llm-d 将总体吞吐量提升了 2.9 倍，并在 Ironwood 等新一代 TPU 芯片上将首字延迟削减逾 85%，标志着面向 AI 智能体时代的企业级分布式推理迈向了高可靠、超弹性的生产就绪阶段。
---
## 📌 执行摘要
> ## Executive Summary
Google Cloud 携手 Red Hat、IBM、CoreWeave 以及 NVIDIA，正式联合发布了 **llm-d 1.0**——这是其开源、云原生 (Kubernetes-native) 分布式推理技术栈的首个正式稳定版本。在北美 PyTorch 开发者大会 (PyTorch Conference North America) 上亮相的 llm-d，能够将碎片化的 vLLM 与 SGLang 模型服务器整合为一个统一协调的弹性资源池。传统轮询负载均衡在应对苛刻的私有化部署 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 与强化学习工作负载时往往捉襟见肘，而 llm-d 专为此类场景量身打造，1.0 版本不仅带来了生产级别的稳定性，还引入了前沿的多租户流控机制以及跨多集群的企业级卓越性能。
> Google Cloud, in collaboration with Red Hat, IBM, CoreWeave, and NVIDIA, has officially released **llm-d 1.0**—the first stable version of its open-source, Kubernetes-native distributed inference stack. Announced at the PyTorch Conference North America, llm-d unifies fragmented vLLM and SGLang model servers into a single coordinated pool. Designed specifically to handle demanding self-hosted agent and reinforcement learning (RL) workloads where traditional round-robin load balancing fails, version 1.0 introduces production-grade reliability, advanced multi-tenant flow control, and enterprise-scale multi-cluster performance.
---
## 什么是 llm-d 1.0？
> ## What is llm-d 1.0?
**llm-d** 诞生于 2025 年，由 Red Hat、IBM 和 Google 联合主导发起，目前已迅速成长为一个蓬勃发展的开源生态，汇聚了来自 25 家以上机构的 500 多名贡献者。该项目于 2026 年 3 月 12 日被正式接纳为 **云原生计算基金会 (CNCF) 沙箱项目 (Sandbox project)**，并严格遵循 **Apache 2.0 开源许可协议**。
> Founded in 2025 and led jointly by Red Hat, IBM, and Google, **llm-d** has grown into a thriving ecosystem featuring over 500 contributors from 25+ organizations. It was accepted as a **CNCF Sandbox project** on March 12, 2026, and is licensed under the **Apache 2.0 license**.
尽管在早期的迭代版本中，团队已经陆续探索并引入了诸如前缀感知路由 (Prefix-Aware Routing)、键值缓存 (KV Cache) 卸载转储、预填充/解码分离解耦 (Prefill/Decode Disaggregation)、超宽专家并行 (Wide Expert Parallelism) 以及批量推理等基石特性，但 **1.0 正式版本** 的核心焦点在于对这些模块进行工业级加固，全面支撑企业在日常生产环境下的持续运维管理 (Day-2 Operations)。
> While earlier iterations introduced foundational features—such as prefix-aware routing, KV cache offloading, prefill/decode disaggregation, wide expert parallelism, and batch inference—**Version 1.0** focuses heavily on hardening these components for production environments (Day-2 operations).
---
## llm-d 1.0 带来哪些全新突破？
> ## What's New in llm-d 1.0?
* **多租户服务质量保障 (QoS)**：兼具优先级与公平感知的 [流量控制机制 (Flow Control)](https://llm-d.ai/docs/well-lit-paths/foundations/flow-control)，有效杜绝了偶发性迸发的智能体循环调用抢占算力、导致对延迟敏感的普通用户请求发生饥饿的现象。 * **稳固的 v1 核心基石**：全链路加固的请求调用路径与标准化的稳定 API，已在多种云平台环境以及异构硬件加速芯片上完成全方位生产验证。 * **零宕机平滑升级**：由热备方案保障的高可用路由网关，辅以创新的 [DisaggregatedSet](https://llm-d.ai/docs/dev/architecture/model-server-orchestration/disaggregatedset) 资源编排机制，支持预填充 (Prefill) 与解码 (Decode) 服务池的安全协同滚动更新。 * **智能体感知服务体系**：具备会话感知的路由策略、话轮优先级调度机制，以及原生的 Responses API 状态管理能力。 * **异步推理处理架构**：通过 [llm-d-async-processor](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-async) 处理器，能够自动从 Google Cloud Pub/Sub 或 Redis 中无缝拉取批处理作业，充分压榨集群中的闲置潮汐算力。 * **扩展的 TPU 原生支持**：深度集成 [TorchTPU](https://developers.googleblog.com/torchtpu-running-pytorch-natively-on-tpus-at-google-scale/)，让 PyTorch 模型能够在 Google TPU 上的上游 vLLM 与 SGLang 实例中原生高能效运行。
> * **Multi-Tenant Quality of Service (QoS):** Priority and fairness-aware [flow control](https://llm-d.ai/docs/well-lit-paths/foundations/flow-control) prevents bursty agent loops from starving latency-sensitive user requests. > * **Stable v1 Foundation:** Hardened request paths and stable APIs validated across multiple cloud environments and diverse hardware accelerators. > * **Zero-Downtime Upgrades:** Router high availability backed by hot standby options, alongside the [DisaggregatedSet](https://llm-d.ai/docs/dev/architecture/model-server-orchestration/disaggregatedset) mechanism, which safely rolls prefill and decode pools together. > * **Agent-Aware Serving:** Session-aware routing, turn-priority scheduling, and native Responses API state management. > * **Asynchronous Inference:** The [llm-d-async-processor](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-async) pulls jobs seamlessly from Google Cloud Pub/Sub or Redis into available slack capacity. > * **Expanded TPU Support:** [TorchTPU](https://developers.googleblog.com/torchtpu-running-pytorch-natively-on-tpus-at-google-scale/) integration enables PyTorch models to run natively inside upstream vLLM and SGLang instances on Google TPUs.
---
## llm-d 如何进行智能请求路由？
> ## How Does llm-d Route Requests?
llm-d 路由器基于 Kubernetes Gateway API 推理扩展 (Inference Extension) 深度构建。它能够动态追踪并掌握各个副本节点分别缓存了哪些特定的上下文提示词前缀，结合当前各服务器的实际负载水线与预估延迟，将新传入的请求毫秒级精准投递至已驻留对应上下文的节点上。
> The llm-d router builds on top of the Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension. It dynamically tracks which replicas hold specific cached prefixes, factors in current server loads and predicted latencies, and routes requests precisely where the necessary context already lives.
当硬件加速芯片的高带宽内存 (High Bandwidth Memory, HBM) 接近饱和时，KV Cache 会通过专用连接组件——如 vLLM 的 `OffloadingConnector`、`Mooncake` 或是 SGLang 的 `HiCache`——平滑转储至宿主机 CPU 内存、本地高速 NVMe SSD 乃至托管的 Lustre (Managed Lustre) 分布式存储中。此外，架构将算力密集的 **预填充 (Prefill)** 任务与显存带宽受限的 **解码 (Decode)** 任务进行彻底物理分离，分别部署在相互独立的优化资源池中，互不干扰。
> When accelerator HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) fills up, the KV cache seamlessly migrates to host CPU memory, local SSDs, or Managed Lustre storage using connectors like vLLM’s `OffloadingConnector`, `Mooncake`, or SGLang’s `HiCache`. Furthermore, compute-heavy **prefill** operations and memory-bound **decode** operations are split into distinct, optimized pools.
---
## 性能基准测试亮点
> ## Benchmark Highlights
已公布的基准测试结果（由 Google、Snap 以及 Zenteiq 官方实测披露）展现了惊人的性能跃升：
> Published benchmarks (self-reported by Google, Snap, and Zenteiq) highlight massive performance gains:
* **Ironwood TPU (TPU 7x)**：前缀感知路由与宿主机内存卸载技术的双剑合璧，将中位数首字延迟 (Time to First Token, TTFT) 大幅削减了 **85% 以上**；与标准 Kubernetes 服务相比，总体吞吐量实现了 **2.4 倍** 的飞跃。 * **Gemini 平台**：提示词前缀缓存命中率直接翻倍，从 **35% 飙升至 70%**。在代码编程智能体场景下，首字延迟降低了超过 35%；在突发高并发对话流量冲击下，P95 首字延迟更是下降了 **50% 以上**。 * **17,000 节点 GKE 超大集群部署**：在跨越 3 个独立计算集群的超大规模部署中，聚合吞吐量提升了 **2.9 倍**，在额外系统开销低于 1% 的前提下始终保持 **99.9% 的请求成功率**。 * **A3 Mega 服务器集群 (70B 模型实测)**：借助托管 Lustre 与宿主机 CPU RAM 内存卸载技术，在处理 50k 超长 Token 提示词时将 TTFT 缩短了 **约 40%**，端到端延迟降低 30%，整体 GPU 机时成本缩减近 60%。 * **强化学习时间片复用 (RL Time-Slicing)**：将推理任务巧妙穿插进强化学习训练的空闲周期中，使硬件加速芯片的有效占空比 (Duty Cycle) 从约 40% **跃升至 70% 以上**。
> * **Ironwood TPU (TPU 7x):** Prefix-aware routing combined with host memory offloading slashed median TTFT (Time to First Token) by **over 85%**, while boosting total throughput **2.4x** compared to standard Kubernetes services. > * **Gemini Platform:** Prefix cache hit rates doubled from **35% to 70%**. TTFT dropped by over 35% for coding agents, and P95 TTFT fell **over 50%** under bursty chat traffic. > * **17,000-Node GKE Deployment:** Scaled aggregate throughput **2.9x** across 3 distinct clusters, maintaining a **99.9% success rate** with under 1% overhead. > * **A3 Mega (70B Model):** Managed Lustre and CPU RAM offloading improved TTFT by **~40%** on 50k-token prompts, reducing end-to-end latency by 30% and GPU-hours by nearly 60%. > * **RL Time-Slicing:** Interleaving inference into idle reinforcement learning cycles lifted the accelerator duty cycle **above 70%** (up from ~40%).
早期采用者的实测数据同样印证了这些里程碑式的提升：**Snap** 报告其前缀缓存命中率攀升至 75%～80%；**Zenteiq** 实现了超过 **4 倍的吞吐量暴涨**（每 1,000 颗 TPU v6e 芯片的日处理 Token 量从 14.7 亿狂飙至 59.7 亿）；而 IBM 的一项实际演示更是成功并发支撑了 **3,000 个编程智能体** 同时高效运行，成本仅为传统标准商业 API 调用的极小一部分。
> Adopter results mirror these milestones: **Snap** reports prefix cache hit rates reaching 75–80%, **Zenteiq** achieved over **4x throughput** (surging from 1.47B to 5.97B daily tokens per 1,000 TPU v6e chips), and an IBM demonstration successfully served **3,000 concurrent coding agents** at a fraction of standard API pricing.
---
## 方案横向对比：llm-d vs. NVIDIA Dynamo vs. AIBrix
> ## Comparative Analysis: llm-d vs. NVIDIA Dynamo vs. AIBrix
| 特性维度 | llm-d 1.0 | NVIDIA Dynamo | AIBrix | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **最新版本** | 1.0 (2026 年 10 月 20 日) | [v1.5.1 (2026 年 10 月 6 日)](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/reference/compatibility) | [v0.7.0 (2026 年 6 月 16 日)](https://github.com/vllm-project/aibrix/releases/tag/v0.7.0) | | **开源协议** | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | | **治理模式** | CNCF 沙箱项目 | NVIDIA 主导 (`ai-dynamo` 组织) | vLLM 项目组织 (源自 ByteDance) | | **支持引擎** | vLLM, SGLang | SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM | vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM | | **适配芯片** | [NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPU 与 Google TPU](https://presentations.cncf.io/projects/llm-d/) | NVIDIA GPU (Blackwell, Hopper, Ada, Ampere) | 异构/混合 GPU 算力 | | **缓存感知路由** | 支持 (前缀与负载联合感知) | 支持 (KV 感知) | 支持 (网关级路由) | | **分层缓存体系** | HBM, CPU, SSD, Managed Lustre | GPU 显存, CPU, SSD, 远端存储 (KVBM) | 分布式 KV 缓存 | | **P/D 预填充与解码解耦** | 支持 (`DisaggregatedSet`) | 支持 | 支持 | | **代表性基准成果** | 17,000 节点下吞吐量提升 2.9 倍 (官方实测) | Qwen3-Coder 480B 首字延迟减半 ([Baseten](https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-baseten-achieved-2x-faster-inference-with-nvidia-dynamo/)) | 未披露 |
> | Feature | llm-d 1.0 | NVIDIA Dynamo | AIBrix | > | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | > | **Latest Version** | 1.0 (Oct 20, 2026) | [v1.5.1 (Oct 6, 2026)](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/reference/compatibility) | [v0.7.0 (Jun 16, 2026)](https://github.com/vllm-project/aibrix/releases/tag/v0.7.0) | > | **License** | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | > | **Governance** | CNCF Sandbox | NVIDIA-led (`ai-dynamo` org) | vLLM project org (ByteDance origin) | > | **Engines** | vLLM, SGLang | SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM | vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM | > | **Accelerators** | [NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, Google TPU](https://presentations.cncf.io/projects/llm-d/) | NVIDIA GPUs (Blackwell, Hopper, Ada, Ampere) | Mixed/Heterogeneous GPUs | > | **Cache-Aware Routing** | Yes (Prefix & load-aware) | Yes (KV-aware) | Yes (Gateway routing) | > | **KV Cache Tiers** | HBM, CPU, SSD, Managed Lustre | GPU, CPU, SSD, remote storage (KVBM) | Distributed KV cache | > | **P/D Disaggregation** | Yes (`DisaggregatedSet`) | Yes | Yes | > | **Headline Result** | 2.9x throughput, 17k nodes (self-reported) | 2x faster TTFT, Qwen3-Coder 480B ([Baseten](https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-baseten-achieved-2x-faster-inference-with-nvidia-dynamo/)) | Not disclosed |
*注：这些分布式推理框架之间是相互补充而非互斥割裂的关系。例如，像 CoreWeave 这样的 AI 云基础设施提供商已将 llm-d 与 Dynamo 协同部署，而 NVIDIA 也在积极将 Dynamo 中的优秀组件反哺贡献至 llm-d 开源生态中。*
> *Note: These tools are complementary rather than mutually exclusive. For instance, infrastructure providers like CoreWeave deploy llm-d alongside Dynamo, and NVIDIA actively contributes Dynamo components back into the llm-d ecosystem.*
---
## 如何上手部署 llm-d 1.0？
> ## How to Deploy llm-d 1.0
在 Google Cloud 平台上，[GKE 推理网关 (GKE Inference Gateway)](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/about-gke-inference-gateway#llm-d-router) 将 llm-d 路由能力包装为全托管云服务，原生支持跨越 [多个集群与不同可用区 (Multiple Clusters and Regions)](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/how-to/setup-multicluster-inference-gateway) 运行并提供全球故障转移容灾。系统结合 KEDA 与 HPA，根据任务排队深度与预估响应延迟动态弹性伸缩工作节点池，同时借助 Kueue 精细化管控每个具体模型的配额。
> On Google Cloud, the [GKE Inference Gateway](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/about-gke-inference-gateway#llm-d-router) provides the llm-d router as a fully managed service capable of spanning [multiple clusters and regions](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/how-to/setup-multicluster-inference-gateway) with global failover. KEDA and HPA scale worker pools based on queue depth and predicted latency, while Kueue manages granular per-model quotas.
对于私有或自定义的 Kubernetes 基础架构环境，官方提供的经过生产验证的 Helm Charts 允许工程团队在统一接入端点后方，轻松快速拉起混合部署的 TPU 与 GPU 算力集群。Google 官方推荐采用循序渐进的分阶段落地策略： 1. **起步阶段**：首先在现有的 vLLM 或 SGLang 部署前端引入前缀感知路由层； 2. **深化阶段**：按需逐步叠加多租户流量控制、[多级分层 KV 缓存卸载转储](https://llm-d.ai/docs/well-lit-paths/foundations/tiered-prefix-cache) 以及预填充与解码解耦架构。
> For custom Kubernetes environments, verified Helm charts allow teams to spin up mixed TPU and GPU fleets behind a unified endpoint. Google recommends a staged adoption path: > 1. Begin by placing prefix-aware routing in front of an existing vLLM deployment. > 2. Incrementally layer in flow control, [tiered KV offloading](https://llm-d.ai/docs/well-lit-paths/foundations/tiered-prefix-cache), and prefill/decode disaggregation.
---
## 核心要点总结
> ## Key Takeaways
* **生产就绪的工业级基石**：llm-d 1.0 带来稳定的 v1 核心 API，专为应对复杂企业级 AI 智能体与大规模强化学习管线进行了深度优化。 * **高阶算力与服务编排**：全面解锁多租户流控保障、路由器高可用热备以及 `DisaggregatedSet` 预填充与解码协同滚动发布等关键架构能力。 * **超大规模实战验证**：在工业级海量负载中久经淬炼——成功将 Google Gemini 平台的提示词前缀缓存命中率翻倍至 70%，并在 17,000 个节点的 GKE 超大集群中斩获了 2.9 倍的吞吐量跃升。
> * **Production-Ready Foundation:** llm-d 1.0 delivers stable v1 APIs optimized for complex enterprise agent and RL pipelines. > * **Advanced Orchestration:** Features new capabilities like multi-tenant flow control, router high availability, and `DisaggregatedSet` rollouts. > * **Proven Scale:** Validated on massive deployments—doubling Gemini prefix cache hit rates to 70% and scaling a 17,000-node GKE cluster by 2.9x.
---

item.title: 重思推理模型的置信度：CALIBER 让 AI 学会准确评估自身不确定性
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/重思推理模型的置信度-CALIBER-让-AI-学会准确评估自身不确定性/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/重思推理模型的置信度-CALIBER-让-AI-学会准确评估自身不确定性/
item.description: 当前主流的推理模型即便能够输出详尽严密的“思维链”步骤，往往也无法可靠地感知并表达自己答案的把握程度 —— 容易出现“一本正经地胡说八道”或盲目自信的问题。针对这一痛点，研究团队提出了创新的置信度校准方法 CALIBER。该方法训练推理模型在解题全流程中给出两个解耦的置信度评分：解题前评估问题难易度的“初始置信度”，以及推导完成后评估答案正确性的“最终置信度”。实验表明，通过协同奖励正确答案与精准的不确定性感知，CALIBER 在数学和通用问答基准测试上将校准误差大幅削减了一半以上，显著增强了大模型“心中有数”的自我认知与差错识别能力。 --- ## 核心概述 > ## Summary 传统的推理模型常常难以可靠地评估并传达自身的不确定性，即使在生成极其详尽的逐步逻辑推导时也是如此。本文提出了 **CALIBER**，一种训练推理模型输出两个独立置信度得分的全新方法：一是在着手解题前评估整体掌控度的**初始置信度** (Initial Confidence)，二是在完成逻辑推理后评估最终输出正确率的**最终置信度** (Final Confidence)。通过同时对准确答案与校准后的不确定性进行奖励，CALIBER 显著降低了校准误差，并在数学及通用问答基准测试中大幅提升了模型区分正确答案与潜在错误的能力。 > Standard reasoning models often struggle to reliably assess and communicate their own uncertainty, even when producing detailed step-by-step logic. This article introduces **CALIBER**, a novel method that trains reasoning models to provide two distinct confidence scores: an **initial confidence** score before solving a problem (judging overall manageability) and a **final confidence** score evaluated after reasoning (assessing the correctness of the final output). By rewarding both accurate answers and calibrated uncertainty, CALIBER significantly reduces calibration error and improves the model's ability to distinguish correct answers from mistakes across math and general question-answering benchmarks. --- ## 引言 > ## Introduction 你掷出两枚质地均匀的六面骰子。它们的点数之和至少为 10 的概率是多少？ > 💬 [原文引用 / Original Quote]: > *You roll two fair six-sided dice. What is the probability that their sum is at least 10?* 面对这个问题，模型起初可能会略显迟疑。随后它开始盘点所有可能的情况：点数和为 10 的情况有 3 种，和为 11 的情况有 2 种，和为 12 的情况有 1 种。在总计 36 种可能的结果中共有 6 种符合要求。*最终答案是 1/6*。 > A model might hesitate at first. Then it counts the possibilities: three ways to roll 10, two ways to roll 11, and one way to roll 12. Six outcomes out of 36. *The answer is 1/6*. 在这个直观示例中，模型刚看到题目时的初始置信度仅为 25%，而在推导完毕后置信度跃升到了 88%。这些百分比描述的是模型对“自己给出正确答案”的把握程度，而非掷骰子事件本身的概率。逐步推演问题的全过程彻底改变了它对自己表现的判断。 > In our illustrative example, the model starts at 25% confidence and finishes at 88%. Those percentages describe its confidence in getting the answer right, not the probability of the dice outcome. Working through the problem has changed its assessment. 置信度的变化当然也可能走向相反的方向。在仔细推敲一道初看十分简单的题目时，深入推导可能会暴露出原本隐含的错误假设或逻辑矛盾。一个真正实用的置信度评估机制，应当能够敏锐捕捉并反映出这种心路历程的变化，即便模型最终依然可能给出错误答案。然而，现有的标准推理模型通常并不具备这种能力：能够生成详尽的推导过程，并不等同于模型能可靠地感知并传达自身的不确定性。 > Confidence can move the other way, too. Reasoning through a solution that initially looks straightforward may reveal a mistaken assumption or a contradiction. A useful confidence estimate should be able to reflect that change, even when the model still gives the wrong answer. However, standard reasoning models do not necessarily come with this ability: producing a detailed reasoning process does not guarantee that a model can reliably assess and communicate its uncertainty. 这正是我们提出 [CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281) 方法的核心初衷：训练推理模型在动笔前先预估自己的成功概率，并在完成具体解答后重新评估该答案的可靠性。在我们的数学基准测试 (Benchmark) 中，经过校准的 7B 模型在该指标上将校准误差降低了一半以上，大幅超越表现最优的单置信度基线。其关键诀窍在于：这两个置信度评估回答的其实是截然不同的两个问题。 > This is the idea behind our method [CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281): train a reasoning model to estimate its chance of success before it begins, then assess its particular answer afterwards. On our math benchmark, the calibrated 7B model reduces calibration error by more than half compared with the best single-confidence baseline on this metric. The key is that the two confidence estimates answer different questions. --- ## 单一置信度掩盖了两个核心问题 > ## One Confidence Score Hides Two Questions 在正式推理前，大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 仅浏览了题目内容。它能够识别该问题所属的领域主题，并判断这道题对自己而言是否可控。此时的置信度回答的是：*“我有多大把握能解出这道题？”* > Before reasoning, the model has only seen the question. It can recognise the topic and judge whether the problem looks manageable. Its confidence answers: *“How likely am I to solve this?”* 而在推理完成之后，模型有了更加具体的评估对象：它自己实际推导出的解答过程。此时面临的问题转变成了：*“这个推导出的答案有多大可能是正确的？”* > After reasoning, it has something more specific to assess: the solution it actually produced. Now the question is: *“How likely is this answer to be correct?”* 这两个预测维度虽然紧密相关，但承担的职能截然不同。初始置信度向用户表明模型是否预期自己能顺利拿下该任务；最终置信度则帮助用户研判产出的具体答案是否需要进一步严密审查。模型在平时可能常常做对同类问题，但在这次尝试中依然可能偶尔失手；反之，它也可能在面对一道棘手难题时起初十分谨慎，随后却找到了一条逻辑闭环、可供自查的精妙解法。 > These predictions are related, but they serve different purposes. Initial confidence gives an indication of whether the model expects to handle the question successfully. Final confidence helps a user judge whether the resulting answer needs closer scrutiny. A model might often solve this kind of problem and still make a mistake on this attempt. Or it might approach a difficult question cautiously, then find a solution it can check. [CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281) 训练模型在同一次回复中完整呈现两项评估：初始置信度、逐步推理、最终答案以及最终置信度。由于推理过程为模型注入了全新的评估信息，前后两个数值完全可以不一致。该机制的终极目标，是让这些置信度打分具有实质的参考价值，从而辅助用户或下游系统科学决策：是直接采纳答案、进行验证复核，还是主动寻求人类专家或外部工具协助。 > [CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281) trains the model to report both estimates in one response: initial confidence, reasoning, an answer, and final confidence. The two numbers can disagree because reasoning gives the model new information to assess. The goal is to make these estimates meaningful enough to support decisions about when to accept an answer, verify it, or seek help. --- ## 明确置信度学习的目标信号 > ## Teaching Confidence What to Predict 为了训练模型的初始置信度，我们让模型对同一道题目进行多次尝试。如果在 10 次尝试中有 7 次答对，那么 70% 就会作为初始置信度的训练目标值。这准确刻画了当前模型在尚未明确具体解答步骤前，解决该问题的整体命中率。 > To train initial confidence, we let the model try the same question several times. If seven out of ten attempts succeed, 70% becomes the training target. That captures how often the current model can solve the question, before we know which particular attempt it will produce. 而最终置信度瞄准的目标则截然不同：即该次具体解答到底是对还是错。针对同一道题目的成功推演与失败推演，共享相同的初始置信度目标，但其最终置信度目标完全不同。下图清晰展示了这一工作机制。 > Final confidence gets a different target: whether that individual answer is correct. A successful and an unsuccessful attempt at the same question share an initial-confidence target, but receive different final-confidence targets. The figure below shows how this works. 在此示例中，4 次尝试中有 3 次成功解出，对应的初始置信度目标值为 75%。第 4 次尝试得出了错误答案，因此其最终置信度目标为 0。图中展示的 60% 与 20% 是模型给出的预测值。训练过程通过奖励机制促使这些预测值更加逼近各自对应的真实目标。 > In this example, three of four attempts succeed, giving an initial-confidence target of 75%. The fourth attempt produces a wrong answer, so its final-confidence target is 0. The displayed 60% and 20% are the model’s predictions. Training rewards it for moving those predictions closer to their respective targets. 我们将上述置信度奖励与回答正确性的奖励相结合。模型既被激励努力解对题目，又被鼓励精准评估自己的胜算。即使回答错误，只要模型准确识别到了推导的不确定性并调低置信度，也能获得一部分置信度奖励，但它无法获得正确答案的高额奖励。这种设计旨在让置信度更加具备实用参考价值，同时确保模型始终将解题正确性放在首位。 > We combine these confidence rewards with a reward for answering correctly. The model is encouraged both to solve the problem and to assess its chances accurately. Recognizing uncertainty about a wrong answer can improve its confidence reward, but it does not earn the reward for a correct solution. The aim is to make confidence more useful while keeping the model focused on getting the answer right. --- ## 为什么每次都说“70% 把握”毫无意义 > ## Why Saying 70 Percent Every Time Is Not Enough 设想有这样一个模型：它回答问题的综合正确率为 70%，并且对每一次作答都一律汇报 70% 的置信度。从统计学上看，它的置信度与全局平均准确率完美契合。但如果你时间有限，只能抽检少数几个答案，这种千篇一律的分数根本无法为你提供任何筛选依据。 > Imagine a model that answers 70% of questions correctly and reports 70% confidence every time. Its confidence matches its overall accuracy perfectly. But if you only have time to check a few answers, those identical scores give you no way to choose. 现在设想另一个具备同等全局准确率的模型：它对其中一半的答案给出 90% 的置信度，对另一半给出 50% 的置信度。如果这两个子集实际对应的准确率恰好分别为 90% 和 50%，那么这个模型同样是校准的。但显然，后者的置信度要实用得多：它能帮助你将审核精力精准聚焦在最可能出现纰漏的作答上。 > Now imagine another model with the same overall accuracy. It assigns 90% confidence to half its answers and 50% to the other half. If those groups are correct 90% and 50% of the time, respectively, this model is also calibrated. Its confidence is more useful, though: it helps you focus your checks on the answers more likely to contain mistakes. 因此，我们在评估模型时综合考察两项指标： * **期望校准误差 (Expected Calibration Error, ECE)**：衡量置信度与实际观察到的准确率是否吻合 —— 在被赋予约 80% 置信度的所有答案中，约 80% 应当是真正正确的。 * **AUROC**：衡量正确答案获得的置信度是否普遍高于错误答案的置信度。 > We therefore evaluate two properties together: > * **Expected Calibration Error (ECE)** measures whether confidence matches observed accuracy: among answers assigned roughly 80% confidence, roughly 80% should be correct. > * **AUROC** measures whether correct answers tend to receive higher confidence than incorrect ones. ECE 越低越好，而 AUROC 越高越好。两项指标相辅相成，共同揭示了置信度数值本身是否足够真实可靠，以及它们能否有效帮助用户甄别潜在的错误。 > Lower ECE and higher AUROC are better. Together, they show whether the confidence values are reliable and whether they help identify likely errors. --- ## 在数学及更广泛基准上的卓越表现 > ## Better Confidence on Math and Beyond 我们在 30,000 道数学题上对 7B 和 30B 参数规模的模型进行了训练，并在 1,000 道保留测试题以及 3 个通用问答基准测试上进行了全面评估。所有对比模型均采用相同的训练配置；“lite”基线则是对早期前人方法的轻量化改进版本。对于 CALIBER，文中报告的校准指标均基于模型的最终置信度进行计算。 > We trained 7B and 30B models on 30,000 math problems and evaluated them on 1,000 held-out problems, plus three question-answering benchmarks. Our comparisons use a shared training setup; the *“lite”* baselines are simplified adaptations of earlier methods. For CALIBER, the reported calibration metrics evaluate final confidence. 在 BigMathDigits 基准上，7B 模型的 ECE 指标从表现最强的单置信度基线的 0.059 骤降至 CALIBER 的 0.028 —— **降幅高达 52.5%**。与此同时，CALIBER 还斩获了最优的 AUROC (0.806) 与 Brier 评分 (0.130)，这表明置信度不仅与实际准确率契合得更紧密，其区分正误的能力也大幅提升。 > On BigMathDigits, the 7B model’s ECE falls from 0.059 for the strongest single-confidence baseline to 0.028 for CALIBER – **a 52.5% reduction**. CALIBER also achieves the best AUROC (0.806) and Brier score (0.130), showing improvements both in how closely confidence matches accuracy and in how well it distinguishes correct answers from mistakes. 这种能力的飞跃并不局限于数学领域。在未进行任何额外训练或任务特定检查点筛选的情况下，与各数据集上表现最强的单置信度基线相比，7B 模型的校准误差在 **GPQA 上降低了 26.8%，TriviaQA 上降低了 32.2%，SimpleQA 上降低了 36.2%**。 > The improvements extend beyond math. Without further training or task-specific checkpoint selection, the 7B model reduces calibration error by **26.8% on GPQA, 32.2% on TriviaQA, and 36.2% on SimpleQA**, compared with the strongest single-confidence baseline on each dataset. 30B 模型的测试结果则有力证明了为何这两个指标必须协同参考。在 BigMathDigits 上，CALIBER 的 ECE 为 0.022，仅略微优于 CoCA-lite 的 0.023。然而 CALIBER 的 AUROC 达到了 0.797，相比之下 CoCA-lite 仅有 0.508 —— 两者在区分正确答案与错误答案的能力上展现出了天壤之别。其他基线在 AUROC 上虽然略高于 CALIBER，但综合效益完全取决于我们衡量的核心侧重点。 > The 30B results show why the metrics matter together. On BigMathDigits, CALIBER’s ECE of 0.022 is only slightly better than CoCA-lite’s 0.023. But its AUROC is 0.797, compared with 0.508 for CoCA-lite: a large difference in how well confidence distinguishes correct from incorrect answers. Other baselines achieve slightly higher AUROC than CALIBER, so the benefit depends on which property we measure. --- ## 置信度的动态变化揭示了什么 > ## What a Change in Confidence Tells Us 引入双重评估机制使我们能够直观观察到模型在经历推导后，是如何修正自身判断的。在 BigMathDigits 上，针对回答正确的题目，7B 模型的平均置信度从初始的 78.5% 攀升至 83.5%；而针对回答错误的题目，其平均置信度则从 62.6% 跌落至 54.5%。在其他数据集上，模型在推理后有时会对两类题目的置信度均有所下调，但错误作答的下调幅度显著更大。 > Having two estimates lets us see whether the model revises its assessment after reasoning. On BigMathDigits, the 7B model’s mean confidence rises from 78.5% to 83.5% for correct answers and falls from 62.6% to 54.5% for incorrect answers. On other datasets, it sometimes lowers confidence for both groups, with a larger decrease for incorrect answers. 因此，置信度的上升或下降是一个背景线索，而非最终判决。两份最终置信度均为 70% 的解答，表达的都是该答案有相同的正确预估概率，哪怕其中一份是从低分上升而来，另一份是从高分滑落而至。最终估值评估的是答案本身；而估值的动态变化则揭示了模型评估心智的演进过程。 > A rise or fall is therefore context, not a verdict. Two answers that finish at 70% confidence express the same estimated probability of correctness, even if one estimate rose and the other fell. The final estimate assesses the answer; the change tells us how the model’s assessment evolved. 在本次实验中，我们主要在单次推理过程的前后进行了测算。随之而来的下一个核心问题是：可靠的置信度动态更新，是否能够有效引导模型自主决策何时进行验证核查、何时检索更多外部信息，亦或何时主动弃权弃答？我们在本项工作中尚未对此类扩展应用进行验证。CALIBER 提供了一个坚实的全新起点：训练置信度以真实反映模型在推理各个阶段所能感知的客观状态。 > Our experiments take this measurement before and after a single reasoning process. A next question is whether reliable confidence updates could help a model decide when to verify, retrieve more information, or abstain. We have not tested those uses here. CALIBER provides a starting point: confidence trained to reflect what the model can assess at each stage of reasoning. 想要了解完整的实验设置与基准数据，请参阅原论文：[CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281)。 > Read the paper for the full experimental setup and results: [CALIBER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24281).

item.title: 统一端侧 AI：Coral NPU 开放标准如何打通从模型到底层芯片的高能效智能
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/统一端侧-AI-Coral-NPU-开放标准如何打通从模型到底层芯片的高能效智能/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/统一端侧-AI-Coral-NPU-开放标准如何打通从模型到底层芯片的高能效智能/
item.description:
在以大模型为核心的人工智能浪潮中，云端算力基础设施已高度标准化，然而端侧 AI (Edge AI) 领域却长期面临着数百种专有芯片架构与互不兼容的编译器工具链割裂的困境，这就是开发者苦不堪言的“碎片化税”。为了打破这一行业桎梏，Google Research 正式推出了 **Coral NPU** 开源软硬件统一标准。本次重磅进展标志着完整 32 位 Coral NPU 硬件架构规范的正式收官，同步发布了首个生产级 v1.0 IREE/MLIR 统一编译器工具链，并联合 Synaptics 推出 Astra SR200 商用级低功耗芯片与全新 Coralboard 开发板。该标准让开发者只需一次调优，即可将轻量大模型无缝部署在各类极低功耗的边缘智能终端与可穿戴设备中，推动端侧通用智能迎来跨硬件平台的新时代。
---
## 执行概要
> ## Executive Summary
当今的云端 AI 基础设施已经高度收敛于成熟的标准软件栈之上，但端侧 AI (Edge AI) 领域却依然深陷于数百种专有芯片架构与互不兼容的编译工具链的严重碎片化泥潭中。为了彻底消除这一阻碍技术落地的“碎片化税 (Fragmentation Tax)”，Google Research 正式推出了 **Coral NPU**——这是一套专为统一端侧计算生态而设计的开放软硬件标准。
> While cloud AI infrastructure has converged around standardized software stacks, edge AI remains heavily fragmented across hundreds of proprietary chip architectures and incompatible toolchains. To solve this "fragmentation tax," Google Research introduced the **Coral NPU**—an open hardware and software standard designed to unify the edge.
本文重点梳理了 Coral 生态系统近期达成的重大里程碑，包括：32 位 Coral NPU 硬件架构的全面竣工、v1.0 版本 IREE/MLIR 统一编译器的正式发布、Synaptics 打造的全新商用芯片，以及进一步拓展的 Coralboard 开发者套件。这些突破性的软硬件进展，让机器学习 (ML) 开发者只需对模型进行一次调优，即可轻松跨越不同的硬件平台与功耗约束进行无缝部署。
> This post highlights major milestones in the Coral ecosystem, including the completion of the 32-bit Coral NPU architecture, the release of the v1.0 IREE/MLIR compiler, new silicon from Synaptics, and expanded Coralboard developer kits. These advancements allow ML developers to optimize a model once and seamlessly deploy it across diverse hardware targets and power envelopes.
---
## 软硬件协同设计：在精准的功耗区间内释放极致性能
> ## Co-designing Silicon and Software: The Right Performance at the Right Power Envelope
![blog-header-image-1600x900](./images/3d25c71ec922.jpg)
端侧 AI 是云端计算架构不可或缺的重要补充：它通过模型级联 (Model Cascading) 机制，能够为用户提供超低延迟、强隐私保护以及离线可靠的实时计算体验。然而，长期以来，面向边缘设备开发 AI 一直饱受芯片架构碎片化的严重拖累——但凡遇到专用硬件不支持的神经网络算子，系统就只能无奈退回至通用 CPU 上执行，从而导致电池电量急剧消耗、响应延迟成倍飙升。
> Edge AI complements cloud infrastructure by providing ultra-low-latency, private, and reliable real-time processing through model cascading. However, building for the edge has historically been hindered by chip fragmentation, where unsupported neural network layers fall back to general-purpose CPUs, draining batteries and increasing latency.
为此，Google 在设计 Coral NPU 硬件架构的同时，同步推进了对应编译器的协同研发。我们不再盲目追求芯片规格书上那些虚高的峰值算力指标，而是将全部重心聚焦于**具备实际能效价值的可用算力 (Energy-viable Compute)**——在严苛受限的功耗区间内，交付最贴合实际应用场景的最佳性能。
> Google designed the Coral NPU architecture and its compiler concurrently. Rather than chasing inflated peak-compute metrics on spec sheets, the focus is on **energy-viable compute**—delivering optimal performance within strict power envelopes.
![architecture_overview](./images/ce2e3b24cb31.png)
---
## 32 位 Coral NPU 硬件架构全面收官
> ## Completing the Coral NPU 32-bit Architecture
![Copy of components_detail_notitle](./images/4a279fcf788a.png)
随着**矩阵执行单元 (Matrix Execution Unit，里程碑 4)** 的正式发布，完整的 32 位 Coral NPU 硬件架构现已正式定型。该架构的演进历程涵盖四大关键里程碑：
> With the release of the **Matrix Execution Unit (Milestone 4)**, the complete 32-bit Coral NPU architecture is finalized. The milestones comprise:
1. **里程碑 1 (Milestone 1)：** 支持 C 语言直接编程的 RISC-V 标量前端，用于灵活的控制流调度； 2. **里程碑 2 (Milestone 2)：** 支持 RVV v1.0 规范的矢量协处理器，用于高效执行 SIMD (单指令多数据流) 运算； 3. **里程碑 3 (Milestone 3)：** 具备浮点运算原生支持的高速紧耦合内存子系统； 4. **里程碑 4 (Milestone 4)：** 矩阵执行单元（遵循 VME 规范），配备专用的外积乘加 (MAC) 硬件引擎，能够在局部寄存器内部单周期完成完整的 2D 分块计算（每时钟周期可执行 256 次乘加运算）。
> 1. **Milestone 1:** A C-programmable RISC-V scalar frontend for control flow. > 2. **Milestone 2:** An RVV v1.0 vector co-processor for SIMD operations. > 3. **Milestone 3:** A tightly coupled memory subsystem with floating-point support. > 4. **Milestone 4:** The Matrix Execution Unit (VME specification), featuring a dedicated outer-product multiply-accumulate (MAC) engine capable of computing a full 2D tile (256 MACs per cycle) inside local registers.
在低于 10 毫瓦 (sub-10 mW) 的极致微功耗区间下，该架构能够仅依靠微型电池供电，持续稳定运行各类多模态 (Multimodal) 复杂工作负载——例如 Gemma 等轻量级 Transformer 大模型、端侧实时语音翻译，以及高保真空间音频降噪滤波等。目前，完整的 [32 位 RTL 硬件描述代码已在 GitHub 全面开源](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu)。
> Operating under a sub-10 mW power envelope, this architecture enables continuous multimodal workloads—such as compact transformer models like Gemma, real-time voice translation, and spatial audio filtering—on small batteries. The complete [32-bit RTL is available on GitHub](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu).
---
## 借助 v1.0 IREE/MLIR 编译器打通“算法模型至物理芯片”的桥梁
> ## Bridging Models to Silicon with the v1.0 IREE/MLIR Compiler
![mlir-compiler-coral (1)](./images/4a6387098d47.jpg)
为了让开发者彻底告别繁琐痛苦的手写汇编编码，Google 正式推出了其 [开源 MLIR/IREE 编译器工具链](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-compiler) 的 v1.0 基石版本。
> To eliminate the need for custom assembly coding, Google is releasing the v1.0 foundation of its [open-source MLIR/IREE compiler toolchain](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-compiler).
该工具链能够将基于 JAX、PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 等主流框架构建的模型（通过 StableHLO 与 TOSA 中间表示）直接编译并映射至 Coral NPU 硬件上运行。编译器会自动接管算子工作负载切分、算子融合以及矩阵分块调优，使其精准匹配片上局部 SRAM 与累加器的物理规格。结合开源的 MPACT 仿真器与参考 FPGA 设计方案，研发团队在物理芯片流片之前，即可对模型运行表现进行全面基准评测，并对芯片硬件配置进行精细微调。
> This toolchain brings models from frameworks like JAX, PyTorch, and TensorFlow (via StableHLO and TOSA) directly to the Coral NPU. It handles workload partitioning, operator fusion, and matrix tiling to fit local SRAM and accumulators. Combined with the open-source MPACT simulator and reference FPGA designs, teams can benchmark models and tune silicon configurations prior to fabrication.
---
## 产业生态落地：商用芯片与硬件载体齐头并进
> ## The Ecosystem in Action: Commercial Silicon and Hardware
要将一项开放硬件标准真正推向全球市场，离不开半导体全产业链的深度合作与协同创新：
> Bringing an open standard to market requires deep collaboration across the semiconductor supply chain:
* **晶圆代工与设计服务合作：** 携手 VeriSilicon 推进设计实现与验证工作，并与 GlobalFoundries 合作基于其 12LP+ FinFET 先进制程进行流片制造。 * **Synaptics Astra® SR200 系列芯片：** 已成功完成流片并于本月正式发布，该芯片深度集成了第二代 Coral NPU IP，在面向可穿戴设备与工业传感器的超低功耗微控制器 (MCU) 封装中，提供了高达 400 GOPS 的算力输出。 * **Coralboard™ SR 开发板：** 搭载 Astra SR200 系列芯片的全新开发套件，专为具身智能 (Physical AI) 与端侧边缘计算的快速原型开发量身打造。 * **Coralboard™ SL 开发板（全球正式商用发售）：** 核心采用 Astra SL2619 处理器，内嵌算力达 1 TOPS 的 Torq™ / Coral NPU 子系统，目前已通过 [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/synaptics-coralboard/720-KDVSL2619-11/29784108) 面向全球市场全面现货发售。
> * **Foundry Partnerships:** Partnering with VeriSilicon for design implementation and verification, and working with GlobalFoundries on their 12LP+ FinFET process. > * **Synaptics Astra® SR200 Series:** Taped out and launching this month, integrating second-generation Coral NPU IP to deliver 400 GOPS in an ultra-low-power MCU package for wearables and industrial sensors. > * **Coralboard™ SR:** A new developer kit powered by the Astra SR200 series for rapid Physical AI and Edge prototyping. > * **Coralboard™ SL (General Availability):** Powered by the Astra SL2619 processor with a 1 TOPS Torq™ / Coral NPU subsystem, now generally available worldwide via [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/synaptics-coralboard/720-KDVSL2619-11/29784108).
---
## 开启 Coral NPU 开发之旅
> ## Start Building with Coral NPU
随着 32 位架构规范与 v1.0 编译器软件栈的全面确立，新一代 64 位 Coral NPU 硬件架构以及具备 CHERI 内存安全机制支持的研发工作已全面启动。
> With the 32-bit architecture and v1.0 compiler stack established, development is already underway for a 64-bit Coral NPU architecture and CHERI security support.
* **阅读官方文档：** 访问 [developers.google.com/coral](https://developers.google.com/coral) 获取架构指南与上手教程。 * **探索开源代码：** 访问 GitHub 获取 [32 位 RTL 硬件代码](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu)、[v1.0 IREE/MLIR 编译器](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-compiler) 以及 [MPACT 硬件仿真器](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-mpact)。 * **选购开发套件：** 在 DigiKey 选购 [Synaptics Coralboard SL](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/synaptics-coralboard/720-KDVSL2619-11/29784108)，并通过 [Synaptics Coralboard 开发者专区](https://www.synaptics.com/coralboard-developer) 深入了解 Astra SR200 系列。
> * **Read the Docs:** Visit [developers.google.com/coral](https://developers.google.com/coral) for architecture guides and tutorials. > * **Explore the Code:** Access the [32-bit RTL](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu), [v1.0 IREE/MLIR compiler](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-compiler), and [MPACT simulator](https://github.com/google-coral/coralnpu-mpact) on GitHub. > * **Get a Devkit:** Order the [Synaptics Coralboard SL](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/synaptics-coralboard/720-KDVSL2619-11/29784108) on DigiKey and explore the Astra SR200 series via the [Synaptics Coralboard Developer page](https://www.synaptics.com/coralboard-developer).

item.title: 将 TorchTPU 深度集成至 TorchTitan：TPU 上的大模型训练与全链路性能优化实战
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/将-TorchTPU-深度集成至-TorchTitan-TPU-上的大模型训练与全链路性能优化实战/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/将-TorchTPU-深度集成至-TorchTitan-TPU-上的大模型训练与全链路性能优化实战/
item.description:
在现代生成式人工智能研发中，大规模基础模型的预训练与微调极度依赖高效、可扩展的分布式计算集群。过去，开发者若想在 Google Cloud TPU 上训练 PyTorch 模型，往往面临两难：要么将整个代码库彻底重构为 JAX，要么受困于复杂的 `torch_xla` 适配工作。为了彻底打通这一壁垒，Google 与 Meta 联合推出了 **TorchTPU** 并深度集成到 **TorchTitan** 中，正式将 TPU 作为原生设备 (`torch.device("tpu")`) 接入 PyTorch 核心架构。通过引入全计算图捕获的 Graph Trainer、对编译器极为友好的 SimpleFSDP 并行机制以及基于 Pallas 的专用高性能算子内核（如 Splash Attention），在 Llama 3、FLUX.1 及 Qwen3 等顶尖大模型上实现了比肩甚至超越 JAX 的极致训练性能与吞吐量。这一重大突破为广大 PyTorch 开发者在大规模 TPU 算力集群上进行前沿模型的高效训练与对齐提供了生产级参考标杆。
---
## 执行概要
> ## Executive Summary
本文详细介绍了将 **TorchTPU** 深度集成至 Meta 旗下分布式训练框架 **TorchTitan** 的全过程，为在 Google Cloud TPU 上训练大规模生成式 AI (Generative AI) 模型构建了原生 PyTorch 后端 (`torch.device("tpu")`)。通过双方联合研发的 TPU 原生执行优化通道 (Execution Passes)、对编译器极为友好的 `SimpleFSDP` 实现方案、全训练步计算图捕获 (Full Training-step Graph Capture)，以及针对 TPU 深度优化的 Pallas 算子内核（例如 Splash Attention），开发者如今能够在 Llama 3、FLUX.1 和 Qwen3 等代表性旗舰模型上，获得与 JAX 旗鼓相当的高性能表现。
> This article details the integration of **TorchTPU** into Meta’s **TorchTitan**, establishing a native PyTorch backend (`torch.device("tpu")`) for training large-scale generative AI models on Google Cloud TPUs. By leveraging co-developed TPU-native execution passes, compile-friendly implementations like `SimpleFSDP`, full training-step graph capture, and optimized Pallas kernels (such as Splash Attention), developers can now achieve near-parity performance with JAX on flagship models like Llama 3, FLUX.1, and Qwen3.
---
![Torch Titan Header Image](./images/386080ba06cc.jpg)
## 引言
> ## Introduction
过去数年间，Meta 打造的 **TorchTitan** 已发展成为 PyTorch 生态中最顶尖的“净室”参考基准平台，专为超大规模生成式 AI 模型的分布式训练而生。TorchTitan 完全基于 PyTorch 原生的扩展原语构建，不仅免去了繁杂的外部依赖，还提供了高度模块化的架构范例，用于预训练诸如 Llama 3、Qwen 3 和 FLUX 等主流稠密模型以及混合专家模型 (Mixture-of-Experts, MoE)。
> Over the past years, Meta’s **TorchTitan** has emerged as the PyTorch ecosystem’s premier clean-room reference platform for large-scale generative AI model training. Built entirely on PyTorch-native scaling primitives, TorchTitan provides an unencumbered, highly modular showcase for pre-training flagship dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures like Llama 3, Qwen 3, and FLUX.
在以往，想要在 **Google Cloud TPU** 上训练 PyTorch 模型的开发者往往面临着艰难抉择：要么将全部代码重写为 JAX 语言，要么硬着头皮去调试老旧复杂的 `torch_xla` 框架。如今，这一技术困境已成为历史。随着 **TorchTPU** 的正式发布，Cloud TPU 拥有了直接集成在 PyTorch 核心接口中的原生后端 (`torch.device("tpu")`)。训练脚本若想调用 TPU 硬件，只需对设备初始化代码进行微小的改动即可。
> Historically, developers looking to train PyTorch models on **Google Cloud TPUs** faced some challenges: either undertake a complete codebase rewrite into JAX, or grapple with legacy `torch_xla`. That paradigm has officially shifted. With the launch of **TorchTPU**, Cloud TPUs now feature a native backend (`torch.device("tpu")`) integrated directly into PyTorch's core interface. Enabling a training script to use TPUs now only requires minimal changes to your device initialization code.
然而，实现硬件设备的兼容只是打赢了“上半场”；开发者在实际生产中更迫切需要的，是开箱即用、高性能且经过实战检验的分布式训练方案 (Distributed Training Recipes)。这正是 **TorchTitan on TPU** 的核心使命。**TorchTitan TPU** 是基于 Meta 官方 TorchTitan 代码库专为适配 Google Cloud TPU 模型训练而深度定制的开源分支，项目已开源托管至 [https://github.com/google-pytorch/torchtitan/](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torchtitan/)。
> Providing device compatibility, however, is only half the battle; developers also need high-performance, production-grade, distributed training recipes. This is where **TorchTitan on TPU** comes in. **TorchTitan TPU** is a fork of Meta’s TorchTitan implementation adapted to enable model training on Google Cloud TPUs, available at [https://github.com/google-pytorch/torchtitan/](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torchtitan/).
## 为什么选择 TorchTitan on TPU
> ## Why TorchTitan on TPU
工程团队不再需要从零开始发明定制化的 TPU 模型切分策略 (Sharding Strategies)，也无需手动编写底层的 XLA 通信优化通路。Google 与 Meta 团队直接在 TorchTitan 内部深度联合研发了 TPU 原生执行通道。TorchTitan 顺理成章地成为了在 Google Cloud TPU 上扩展 PyTorch 训练规模的权威核心载体。
> Rather than requiring engineering teams to invent custom TPU sharding strategies or hand-craft low-level XLA communication passes from scratch, Google and Meta co-developed TPU-native execution passes directly inside TorchTitan. TorchTitan serves as the definitive vehicle for scaling PyTorch on Google Cloud TPUs.
![image1 (7)]("./images/b9386a24c142.png")

item.title: 如何使用决策模型进行自动化评估：平衡成本、性能与置信度
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/如何使用决策模型进行自动化评估/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/如何使用决策模型进行自动化评估/
item.description:
随着大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 在各类业务系统中的广泛落地，如何低成本、高效率地对其输出质量进行自动化评估 (Evals) 成为了工业界的核心痛点。传统方案往往依赖昂贵且耗时的大模型裁判 (LLM Judge)，而专门的“决策模型 (Decision Models)”以其轻量、低延迟和低成本的分类能力正在快速崛起。本文通过真实智能体业务链路的测试数据，深入对比了 Perplexity、Liquid、Cloudflare 及 OpenAI 等主流决策模型的性能与成本权衡，并系统介绍了阈值微调与概率校准的关键实战技巧，为开发者搭建高性价比的自动化评估流水线提供了清晰指南。
---
## 核心内容摘要
> ## Summary
决策模型（例如 TypeSafe 的 Jev、Perplexity 的 Decider、Liquid 的 d1、Cloudflare 的 Clef 以及 OpenAI 的 Decisions API）作为传统大语言模型裁判 (LLM Judge) 的替代方案迅速崛起。它们在自动化评估场景中表现出分类速度快、调用成本极低的优势。然而，它们能否真正发挥效能，很大程度上取决于你对成本、性能以及延迟 (Latency) 的具体业务需求。
> Decision models—such as TypeSafe’s Jev, Perplexity’s Decider, Liquid’s d1, Cloudflare’s Clef, and OpenAI’s Decisions API—have emerged as fast, inexpensive classification alternatives to traditional LLM judges for automated evaluations. However, their effectiveness depends heavily on your specific requirements for cost, performance, and latency.
本指南深入探讨了如何合理配置与评估决策模型，而不是盲目依赖默认设置。核心要点包括：
> This guide explores how to properly configure and evaluate decision models instead of relying on default settings. Key takeaways include:
* **阈值调优 (Threshold Tuning)**：系统默认的 0.50 决策阈值往往无法充分发挥模型潜力。根据具体的准确率 (Precision) 和召回率 (Recall) 目标调优阈值，能够显著改善评估效果。 * **成本与性能权衡**：在本次实测中，虽然 OpenAI Decisions 取得了最高的 F1 分数，但调用成本相对较高；而 Perplexity 与 Liquid d1-ultra 则提供了性价比极佳的轻量替代方案。 * **概率校准 (Probability Calibration)**：决策模型输出的分数不仅能做判决，还可作为置信度预估。然而，这些原生概率往往需要经过校准（如采用 Platt 缩放算法），才能真实映射现实中的失败率。 * **持续迭代优化**：将特定业务领域的提示词 (Prompt) 与严谨的阈值调优、概率校准手段相结合，能确保自动化评估结果与人类的真实偏好高度对齐。
> * **Threshold Tuning:** The default decision threshold of 0.50 often leaves performance on the table. Tuning thresholds based on your precision and recall goals significantly improves outcomes. > * **Cost vs. Performance:** While OpenAI Decisions delivered the highest F1 score in our tests, it came at a higher price point, whereas models like Perplexity and Liquid d1-ultra offer budget-friendly alternatives. > * **Probability Calibration:** Decision model scores can double as confidence estimates, but they often require calibration (such as Platt scaling) to accurately reflect observed failure rates. > * **Iterative Improvement:** Combining domain-specific prompts with rigorous threshold and calibration checks ensures your automated evals closely align with human preferences.
---
## 实测方案设计
> ## What We Tested
我们从一个真实的公寓租赁 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 业务流中抽取了 100 条追踪记录 (Traces，即完整的对话与工具调用行为日志)，旨在精准识别各类交互错误，例如预约看房失败或未能及时转接人工客服等。每个决策模型都会针对每条追踪记录输出一个失败概率。
> We used 100 traces (logs of conversations and actions) from an apartment leasing agent to identify errors, such as a failed booking or a missed handoff to a human. Each decision model returned a failure probability for each trace.
我们在完全一致的评估准则下，对 **Jev 1.13**、**Perplexity Decider 1.1 27B**、**Liquid d1 和 d1-ultra**、**Cloudflare Clef Flash** 以及 **OpenAI Decisions (GPT-6 Luna)** 进行了横向评测。所有模型均围绕两大核心维度展开对比：
> We tested **Jev 1.13**, **Perplexity Decider 1.1 27B**, **Liquid d1 and d1-ultra**, **Cloudflare Clef Flash**, and **OpenAI Decisions (GPT-6 Luna)** using identical evaluation criteria. Models were compared across two core dimensions:
* **性能表现**：将模型的预测判断与经过人工复核的通过/失败 (Pass/Fail) 真实标签进行对照。 * **调用成本**：依据 Token 使用量及各家服务商的定价方案计算实际 API 支出。
> * **Performance:** Comparing model predictions against human-reviewed pass/fail labels. > * **Cost:** Calculating API costs based on token usage and provider pricing.
---
## 深入理解决策模型与判断阈值
> ## Understanding Decision Models and Thresholds
我们为每条追踪日志赋予二元的通过/失败标签，以此建立清晰明确、与人类偏好保持一致的评判标准。决策模型会输出一个介于 0 到 1 之间的概率分值，用于表示该用例发生失败的可能性。
> We assign each trace a binary pass/fail label, encouraging clear criteria that align with human preferences. Decision models output a score from 0 to 1 indicating the likelihood of a failure.
在默认情况下，各家 API 通常采用 **0.50 作为决策阈值**，即只要分值达到或超过 0.50 就判定为失败。然而，如果不结合自身数据分布就直接套用默认阈值，往往会导致较差的评估效果。挑选恰当的阈值，本质上是在以下两个关键指标之间寻找平衡：
> By default, APIs use a **decision threshold of 0.50**, flagging anything at or above this mark as a failure. However, accepting this default without checking your data can lead to poor results. Choosing the right threshold requires balancing:
* **准确率 (Precision)**：在模型标记为失败的所有用例中，真正存在已知缺陷的比例。 * **召回率 (Recall)**：在所有已知存在的真实缺陷中，被模型成功捕捉拦截的比例。
> * **Precision:** The share of flagged traces that contain a known failure. > * **Recall:** The share of known failures successfully caught by the model.
我们采用 **F1 分数**（准确率与召回率的调和平均数）来综合衡量模型的整体表现，该分值越高，代表模型在查准与查全之间的平衡做得越出色。
> We measure performance using the **F1 score** (the harmonic mean of precision and recall), where higher scores indicate better balance.

item.title: 基于受信任虚拟机的机密推理：Anthropic 构筑用户隐私与模型权重安全屏障
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/基于受信任虚拟机的机密推理-Anthropic-构筑用户隐私与模型权重安全屏障/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/基于受信任虚拟机的机密推理-Anthropic-构筑用户隐私与模型权重安全屏障/
item.description:
数以百万计的用户每天向大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 交付私有代码、商业战略等高敏感数据，如何在享受顶尖 AI 生产力的同时实现绝对的数据保密，已成为 AI 产业亟待攻克的信任基石。为此，Anthropic 携手 Pattern Labs 展开前沿安全研究，正式公布了名为“机密推理 (Confidential Inference)”的技术框架。该方案依托基于硬件隔离的受信任虚拟机 (Trusted Virtual Machine) 与密码学度量机制，构建起端到端的强信任链，确保敏感数据——无论是用户输入的提示词还是前沿模型自身的核心权重，除在受到硬件密码学隔离与代码签名远程验证的极小执行区瞬时解密外，在其余所有传输与存储链路中始终保持全密文形态。这项突破性探索不仅从根本上化解了云端隐私外泄的隐忧，更为主权级模型资产保护树立了全新的技术标杆。
---
## 摘要
> ## Summary
Anthropic 正在积极研发**机密推理 (Confidential Inference)** 技术，这是一套旨在通过密码学手段为用户数据隐私和模型权重安全提供绝对保障的核心工具集。在与 Pattern Labs 的合作研发中，该项目确保了各类敏感数据（如用户提交的提示词和模型核心专有权重）在整个系统生命周期内全程处于高强度加密状态，仅在受限、可验证且由硬件物理隔离的专属环境中进行实际计算时才被短暂解密。
> Anthropic is researching and developing **Confidential Inference**, a set of tools designed to provide cryptographic guarantees for user data privacy and model weight security. Published in collaboration with Pattern Labs, this initiative ensures that sensitive data (such as user prompts and proprietary model weights) remains encrypted everywhere except inside restricted, verifiable, and hardware-isolated environments during active processing.
---
## 前言
> ## Introduction
每天有数以百万计的用户将高度敏感的信息交付给 Claude，涵盖专有核心代码、商业战略规划乃至机密企业情报。为了将这种基于人际合同的信任升华为密码学级别的确定性保障，Anthropic 正全力研发**机密推理 (Confidential Inference)** 框架——该架构能够确保加密数据只在那些具备密码学自证能力的受信任服务器内部被解密与计算。
> Millions of users entrust Claude with sensitive information, ranging from proprietary code to confidential business strategies. Anthropic is researching ways to make this trust cryptographically guaranteed through **Confidential Inference**—a framework that processes encrypted data only within servers that can prove themselves trustworthy.
引入这套机密计算工具主要服务于两大核心目标：
1. **模型权重安全 (Model Weight Security)**：全面保护 Claude 等前沿模型的核心资产，抵御高级持续性威胁 (APT) 攻击者的窃取； 2. **用户数据安全 (User Security)**：在密码学层面严格证实用户的敏感数据享有绝对隐私，不受任何第三方及云端宿主的窥探。
> Adopting these tools serves two primary purposes: > 1. **Model Weight Security:** Securing frontier models like Claude against advanced threat actors. > 2. **User Security:** Proving that sensitive user data remains private.
*阅读完整学术白皮书：[机密推理技术论文 (Confidential Inference Paper)](https://assets.anthropic.com/m/c52125297b85a42/original/Confidential_Inference_Paper.pdf)*。
> *Read the full [Confidential Inference Paper](https://assets.anthropic.com/m/c52125297b85a42/original/Confidential_Inference_Paper.pdf).*
---
## 推理服务体系架构
> ## Inference Service
机密推理的核心准则在于：所有敏感数据除在实际发生计算的瞬时点外，必须在任何环节均处于加密状态。为了落地这一铁律，Anthropic 融合了前沿的机密计算 (Confidential Computing) 理念，在系统内部构建起牢不可破的信任链 (Chain of Trust)。
> The core principle of Confidential Inference is that sensitive data must remain encrypted except at the exact point of processing. To enforce this, Anthropic uses confidential computing principles to build a chain of trust.
对于用户输入的数据，全系统仅在以下两个阶段短暂接触明文 (Cleartext)：
* **API 服务器 (The API Server)**：接收原始提示词，将其编码转换为 Token，并执行处理 Claude API 请求所必需的控制流逻辑。 * **推理服务器 (The Inference Server)**：在专用硬件加速器上运行 Claude 的核心神经网络“大脑”，进而自回归生成最终的补全 Token。（*对于专有模型权重而言，仅有推理服务器有权触碰这些关键敏感资产*）。
> For user data, cleartext (unencrypted text) handling occurs at two points: > * **The API Server:** Handles prompts, transforms them into tokens, and operates logic behind Claude API requests. > * **The Inference Server:** Runs the "brains" of Claude on hardware accelerators to generate completion tokens. *(For model weights, only the Inference Server receives sensitive data).*
鉴于目前市面上绝大部分底层硬件加速器尚未完全原生普及机密计算特性，Anthropic 另辟蹊径，在受信任执行环境中部署了一个小巧而坚固的**“模型加载与调用器 (Model Loader and Invoker)”**来作为安全桥梁。
> To work around hardware accelerators that do not yet fully support confidential computing, Anthropic is exploring a small, secure **"model loader and invoker"** running within a trusted environment.

item.title: 借助 Model Explorer 为定制端侧编译器引入可视化计算图调试
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/借助-Model-Explorer-为定制端侧编译器引入可视化计算图调试/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/借助-Model-Explorer-为定制端侧编译器引入可视化计算图调试/
item.description:
将现代机器学习模型部署到各类低功耗边缘设备时，通常需要经历量化、图下沉 (Graph Lowering)、算子融合与硬件委派 (Delegation) 等复杂的编译链路。然而，编译器底层生成的中间表示 (Intermediate Representation, IR) 往往极其晦涩，工程师过去只能通过解析生硬的二进制 Flatbuffers 或海量文本日志来排查算子异常和硬件回退，过程繁琐且极易出错。为此，Arm 团队与 Google 深度合作，借助 Google AI Edge Model Explorer 的层级图可视化与插件架构，开发了一系列针对 TOSA、VGF 和 PTE 等专用中间格式的开源适配器。本文详细介绍了 Arm 如何通过分屏对照、节点级性能追踪热力图等可视化调试工作流，秒级定位意外引入的转置算子、精准验证 NPU 硬件加速委派，并一目了然地捕捉时钟周期级的硬件延迟瓶颈。
---
## 摘要
> ## Summary
Model Explorer 的能力不仅限于展示高层级模型计算图，更能为本地端侧机器学习部署流水线提供深度的可视化洞察。本文将深入探讨 Arm 如何将 Google AI Edge Model Explorer 与定制编译器中间表示 (Intermediate Representation, IR)——例如 TOSA、VGF 和 PTE 等深度集成，从而通过并排分屏比对验证 NPU 硬件委派情况，并将周期级 (Cycle-level) 性能剖析追踪数据直接映射至底层执行图中。
> Model Explorer extends beyond high-level model graphs to provide deep visibility into local edge machine learning pipelines. This article explores how Arm integrated Google AI Edge Model Explorer with custom compiler intermediate representations (IRs)—such as TOSA, VGF, and PTE—to verify NPU hardware delegation side-by-side and map cycle-level profiling traces directly onto execution graphs.
---
## 前言
> ## Introduction
从低功耗边缘设备、游戏显卡到具身物理 AI 系统，机器学习模型正运行在日益多样化的本地硬件环境之中。要在这些目标平台上实现高效推理，离不开一系列关键的编译步骤，例如模型量化、图下沉 (Graph Lowering)、算子融合以及针对专用加速器的硬件委派。
> Machine learning models run locally on a wide range of hardware, from low-power edge devices to gaming graphics and physical AI systems. Running models efficiently on these targets requires compilation steps such as quantization, graph lowering, operator fusion, and hardware delegation.
为了让开发者能够对这些复杂的流水线拥有清晰的可视化掌控力，Arm 引入了 **[Google AI Edge Model Explorer](https://developers.google.com/edge/model-explorer)**。依托 Model Explorer 出色的分层计算图可视化能力与灵活的插件架构，Arm 打造了多款开源适配器，让端侧模型的各项编译转换过程变得直观易审。
> Arm used **[Google AI Edge Model Explorer](https://developers.google.com/edge/model-explorer)** to give developers visibility into these pipelines. With Model Explorer's hierarchical graph visualization and plugin architecture, Arm built several open-source adapters that make edge model transformations easier to inspect.
![Arm MEX_Blog Hero (1)](./images/c16d4baf977d.png)
---
## 核心痛点与挑战
> ## The Challenge
在将模型部署至端侧硬件的过程中，上游框架的细微改动或算子约束条件的微调，都可能导致最终导出的执行图结构发生剧烈变化。工程师往往必须回答以下三个关键问题：
> When deploying a model to edge hardware, a framework change or operator constraint can alter the exported execution graph. Engineers often need to answer three critical questions:
* **图结构完整性 (Structural integrity)**：图下沉编译过程是否意外引入了多余算子（例如未经计划的布局转置算子）？ * **硬件加速委派 (Hardware delegation)**：模型是否已全量委派至 NPU 或 GPU 硬件加速器运行？还是有部分不被支持的子图悄悄回退 (Fallback) 到了 CPU 上？ * **时钟周期级性能瓶颈 (Cycle-level bottlenecks)**：在下沉后的执行图中，究竟是哪些计算节点消耗了最多的硬件时钟周期？
> * **Structural integrity:** Did graph lowering introduce unintended operators such as extra layout transposes? > * **Hardware delegation:** Is the model fully delegated to the NPU or GPU, or are unsupported subgraphs falling back to the CPU? > * **Cycle-level bottlenecks:** Which nodes in the lowered graph take the most compute cycles?
以往仅凭肉眼阅读原始 Flatbuffers 二进制结构或滚动翻阅海量文本日志来解答这些问题，不仅效率极其低下，而且面对大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 以及深层神经网络时更是如同大海捞针。Arm 迫切需要一款直观的可视化工具，用于深入审查 Arm 特有的中间表示与底层硬件性能分析追踪。
> Answering these questions by reading raw flatbuffers or text logs takes time, especially for large language models (LLMs) and neural networks. Arm needed a visual tool to inspect Arm-specific intermediate representations and hardware profiling traces.
---
## Arm 如何构建 Model Explorer 可视化调试工作流
> ## How Arm Used Model Explorer's Visual Debugging Workflows
为了攻克上述端侧部署难题，Arm 为 Google AI Edge Model Explorer 量身开发了多款定制适配器，全面支持多种关键模型格式（如 **[TOSA](https://www.mlplatform.org/tosa/tosa_spec.html)**、**[VGF](https://docs.pytorch.org/executorch/stable/tutorial-arm-vgf.html)** 和 **[PTE](https://docs.pytorch.org/executorch/stable/pte-file-format.html)**），从而建立起一套端到端设备端优化可视化工作流。借助这些扩展，工程团队可以直接在模型计算图上校验导出流水线、核验硬件加速委派状态，并秒级锁定周期级性能瓶颈：
> To address these deployment challenges, Arm developed custom adapters for Google AI Edge Model Explorer to support several model formats (i.e., **[TOSA](https://www.mlplatform.org/tosa/tosa_spec.html)**, **[VGF](https://docs.pytorch.org/executorch/stable/tutorial-arm-vgf.html)**, and **[PTE](https://docs.pytorch.org/executorch/stable/pte-file-format.html)**), establishing a comprehensive visual workflow for on-device optimization. Using these extensions, engineering teams can validate exported pipelines, verify accelerator delegation, and pinpoint cycle-level performance bottlenecks directly on the model graph:

item.title: TorchTPU：Google 与 Meta 联手打造原生 PyTorch 的 TPU 混合即时与编译执行架构
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/TorchTPU-Google-与-Meta-联手打造原生-PyTorch-的-TPU-混合即时与编译执行架构/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/TorchTPU-Google-与-Meta-联手打造原生-PyTorch-的-TPU-混合即时与编译执行架构/
item.description:
长期以来，深度学习开发者在使用 Google 自研的张量处理单元 (Tensor Processing Unit, TPU) 时，往往面临着框架生态割裂的痛点——主流的 PyTorch 模型在迁移至 TPU 平台时，经常遭遇繁琐的环境适配门槛或运行时效率折损。为了彻底打破这一算力生态壁垒，Google 与 Meta 两大科技巨头展开前所未有的深度开源合作，联合推出了专为 Google TPU 量身定制的原生后端架构 **TorchTPU**。该架构创造性地融合了动态即时执行 (Eager Execution) 优化与现代 `torch.compile` 图编译加速技术，不仅让海量现成 PyTorch 模型无需任何代码改动即可在 TPU 集群上“开箱即用”极速运转，更在模型推理与分布式训练中释放出具备行业顶尖竞争力的硬件性能。这项重磅突破理顺了 PyTorch 开发者迈向 TPU 算力底座的平滑迁移之路，标志着全球顶级 AI 硬件与主流算法生态正加速走向深度的底层大融合。
---
## 核心概要
> ## Summary
**TorchTPU** 是 Google 与 Meta 联手推出的开源重大合作成果，旨在为 Google 张量处理单元 (Tensor Processing Unit, TPU) 构建一套原生且符合设计规范的 PyTorch 官方级硬件后端。通过创造性地结合动态即时执行 (Eager Execution) 优化、`torch.compile` 深度编译集成与底层原生硬件加速，该架构为大模型的实时推理与大规模训练注入了极具行业竞争力的顶尖性能，同时大幅简化了现有 PyTorch 模型的开箱即用运行与 TPU 迁移流程。
> **TorchTPU** is an open-source collaboration between Google and Meta designed to introduce a native, principled PyTorch backend for Google Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). By combining eager execution optimizations, `torch.compile` integration, and native hardware acceleration, the architecture delivers industry-competitive performance for both model inference and training while streamlining out-of-the-box model execution and TPU migration.
---

item.title: Hugging Face 携手 TorchTPU：让 TPU 获得原生 PyTorch 支持
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/Hugging-Face-携手-TorchTPU-让-TPU-获得原生-PyTorch-支持/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-21/Hugging-Face-携手-TorchTPU-让-TPU-获得原生-PyTorch-支持/
item.description:
长期以来，PyTorch 开发者若想使用 Google 强大的 TPU 算力集群，往往受制于 `torch_xla` 复杂的惰性求值图与 JAX 的学习成本，难以像在 GPU 上那样随心所欲。随着 **TorchTPU** 原生后端的推出，TPU 正式成为了 PyTorch 的一等公民设备 (`torch.device("tpu")`)。Hugging Face 宣布全面支持该特性，Transformers、Diffusers 和专有 Kernels 库均已原生适配 TPU，开发者仅需一行 `device_map="tpu"` 或 `.to("tpu")` 即可开箱运行最新前沿模型。无论是百亿多模态生成、高吞吐 MoE 解码，还是结合 Pallas 定制算子加速，开发者都能享受到与原生 PyTorch 完全一致的丝滑开发体验。
---
## 概要
> ## Summary
随着 **TorchTPU** 的横空出世，Google 的张量处理单元 (Tensor Processing Unit, TPU) 终于能够作为原生 PyTorch 设备直接调用。这项集成彻底摆脱了以往受制于 `torch_xla` 或 JAX 的固有约束，使得 Hugging Face 旗下的核心开源库（包括 Transformers、Diffusers 以及定制算子库 Kernels）能够直接在 TPU 上开箱即用——开发者只需简单指定 `device_map="tpu"` 或调用 `.to("tpu")` 即可畅行无阻。
> With the introduction of **TorchTPU**, Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) can now act as native PyTorch devices. This integration bypasses the historical constraints of `torch_xla` or JAX, allowing Hugging Face libraries like Transformers, Diffusers, and specialized Kernels to run seamlessly on TPUs out of the box—just by targeting `device_map="tpu"` or `.to("tpu")`.
---
![The Hugging Face mascot and a smiling PyTorch logo cheering over a glowing chip, on a manga-style background.](./images/e168966f02f0.jpg)
如果你曾经尝试过在 TPU 上运行 PyTorch 代码，很大概率不得不经历将代码大改迁移至 `torch_xla` 的痛苦，或者最终被迫从零去学 JAX。而随着原生 PyTorch 后端 [TorchTPU](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torch_tpu) 的发布，TPU 如今变成了与常规设备无异的又一个标准计算目标。这为 Hugging Face 生态全面拥抱 TPU 铺平了道路：Transformers、Diffusers 以及 Kernels 均已实现 TPU 原生运行。只需从 Hub 上挑选你中意的模型，将其分配至 `"tpu"`，一切便大功告成。
> If you ever tried to run PyTorch on a TPU, you probably ported your code to `torch_xla`, or you ended up having to learn JAX. With [TorchTPU](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torch_tpu), a native PyTorch backend, TPU is now just another device. It opens up native support of TPU in the Hugging Face ecosystem. Transformers, Diffusers and Kernels run natively on TPU. Pick a model from the Hub, send it to `"tpu"`, and you're done.
## 等等，到底什么是 TPU？ 🤔
> ## Wait, what's a TPU? 🤔
TPU 是 [张量处理单元 (Tensor Processing Unit)](https://cloud.google.com/tpu) 的英文缩写。TPU 是 Google 自主研发的专用 AI 加速芯片，其设计初衷纯粹为了极致做好一件事：加速神经网络耗时最集中的矩阵数学运算。Google 研发设计 TPU 已有大约十年时间，并长期使用它们来训练和服务自家的大规模旗舰模型，包括著名的 Gemini。
> TPU stands for [Tensor Processing Unit](https://cloud.google.com/tpu). TPUs are Google's own AI accelerators. They are chips built for one job: the matrix math that neural networks spend most of their time on. Google has been designing them for about ten years, and uses them to train and serve its own models, including Gemini.
开发者可以在 [Google Cloud](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/intro-to-tpu) 上随时取用 TPU 算力，从小到单个独立芯片，大到由数千颗芯片构成的 Pod 超级集群均可调用。当你在模型训练或大规模推理服务中需要澎湃算力时，TPU 的强大性能便能大放异彩。
> TPUs are available on [Google Cloud](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/intro-to-tpu), from a single chip up to pods of thousands of chips. They shine when you need a lot of compute, for training or for serving at scale.
但一直以来的瓶颈在于软件生态。TPU 的软件栈最早完全是围绕 TensorFlow 和 JAX 逐步生长起来的，这使得习惯了 PyTorch 的开发者想要接入 TPU 往往要克服很高的门槛。
> The catch has always been software. The TPU stack grew up around TensorFlow and JAX, and PyTorch users had to work harder to get in.
## 过去传统的开发模式
> ## The old way
在此之前，在 TPU 上跑 PyTorch 意味着必须通过 PyTorch/XLA (`torch_xla`) 中间层。虽然它能够正常工作，但存在诸多难以回避的特异行为：张量计算是惰性求值 (Lazy Evaluation) 的，你的代码并不总是像预想的那样立即执行；极其微小的代码变动都可能触发计算图的昂贵重编译；而排查调试问题时，代码执行逻辑更是晦涩难懂。
> Until now, running PyTorch on TPUs meant going through PyTorch/XLA (`torch_xla`). It worked, but it had its quirks. Tensors were lazy, so your code didn't always run when you thought it did. Small changes could trigger graph recompilations, and debugging was hard to reason about.
为了减轻开发者的负担，我们此前打造了 Optimum TPU，为 Hugging Face 模型在 TPU 上的推理与训练提供桥接支持。而如今 TorchTPU 带来了底层原生支持，开发者在使用 Transformers 和 Diffusers 运行模型时，已经不再需要额外依赖 Optimum TPU 了。
> To make life easier, we built Optimum TPU. It gave Hugging Face models inference and training support on TPUs. Now that TorchTPU brings native support, Optimum TPU is not required anymore to run Hugging Face models with Transformers and Diffusers.
## 迎接 TorchTPU 登场 🚀
> ## Enter TorchTPU 🚀
[TorchTPU](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torch_tpu) 将 TPU 作为全新原生后端直接接入了 PyTorch。你可以继续书写真正纯正的 PyTorch 代码。它不仅内置了针对 TPU 深度优化的 Pallas 算子内核，全面支持分布式训练，还深度集成了 `torch.compile` 以便在需要极致性能时一键提速。在 TPU 虚拟机 (VM) 上的安装仅需一行简单命令：
> [TorchTPU](https://github.com/google-pytorch/torch_tpu) adds TPU as a new backend to PyTorch. You write regular PyTorch code. It comes with Pallas kernels tuned for TPUs, support for distributed training, and a `torch.compile` integration for when you want more speed. Installing it on a TPU VM takes one command:
```shell pip install torch-tpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu ```
这里指定的额外索引源提供了针对 CPU 编译优化的精简版 `torch`。如果不加这个参数，pip 会默认拉取体积庞大得多的 CUDA 编译版本，而这在 TPU 环境中完全是不必要的。
> The extra index gives you the CPU build of `torch`. Without it, pip pulls the much bigger CUDA build, which you don't need on a TPU.
## 你所钟爱的开源库，如今已全面支持 TPU
> ## Your favourite libraries, now on TPU
